savingTips.title: Saving and investing principles
savingTips.payYourselfFirst: Pay yourself first — move money to savings as soon as your salary arrives.
savingTips.autoTransfer: Set up an automatic transfer on payday so you don't forget or spend it first.
savingTips.reviewYearly: Review your financial plan at least once a year.
savingTips.nearRetirement: As retirement gets closer (under 10 years away), gradually reduce your stock allocation to lower risk.

comparison.title: Comparing corpus calculation methods
comparison.note: When the post-retirement period is exactly 25 years, the simple method and the 4% rule always give the same result — this is not a bug.

disclaimer.title: Please note
disclaimer.body: This calculation is an estimate for educational purposes only, based on the assumptions you entered and expected rates of return that may not occur in reality. Past performance does not guarantee future returns, and investing carries the risk of losing principal. This website is not licensed investment advice. Before making real investment decisions, please consult a licensed investment advisor authorized by the Thai SEC.

results.pensionAssumption: The pension is calculated from the today's-value amount you entered, adjusted using the same inflation rate as your expenses.
results.pensionSufficient: Your expected pension is already sufficient to cover your expenses — no additional corpus is needed.

personalIncomeTaxCalculator.title: Try calculating personal income tax yourself
personalIncomeTaxCalculator.monthlyIncomeHelper: Assumes a regular salaried job, excluding bonuses or other income
personalIncomeTaxCalculator.monthlyModeHelper: Enter each month's actual income, such as months with higher commission or bonuses. Tax is calculated on total annual income, so the result is accurate whether or not each month is equal.
personalIncomeTaxCalculator.scopeNote: Covers salaried income only, using the standard expense deduction and personal allowance. It excludes other deductions such as social security, SSF/RMF funds, a spouse, or children, so your actual tax may be lower.
